summary: A 27-year-old man was killed and a 31-year-old woman was injured when their 1999 Dodge SUV went off U.S. 50 and into the Arkansas River near mile marker 227 in Wellsville early in the morning; the woman was taken to Heart of the Rockies Regional Medical Center with unknown injuries, and the man's body was recovered from the river by emergency responders later that morning.
responding_agency: Fremont County Sheriff's Office; Colorado State Patrol; Colorado Parks and Wildlife; Salida Fire Department
notes: Date pinned 2017-11-01: article reports the wreck "early Wednesday morning" and 2017-11-01 was a Wednesday (America/Denver). Victims unnamed in article (male 27, female 31).
